content:
- Overestimate prices when sentiment is positive (especially >0.67) — reduce forecast by 1–3% for consecutive positive sentiment.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is negative (especially <0.33) — increase forecast by 1–3% for consecutive negative sentiment.
- Overshoot after recent spikes — cap forecast at 10–15% below peak if sentiment turns neutral or negative.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 3+ consecutive forecasts are above 80, adjust downward by 1–2% per day if sentiment is weak or mixed.
- Lagged overreaction: if forecast is high 3–5 days after a spike, reduce by 2–5% if sentiment is still positive but fading.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts tend to overestimate early in the cycle — apply 1–3% downward correction if sentiment is trending upward.
